name: schedule_orientation_followup
description: schedule_orientation_followup: Schedule an orientation follow-up appointment for a new hire after onboarding tasks have been completed. The appointment must be at a time slot that has been confirmed as available.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP072948

appointment_datetime.description: The appointment date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. Must be a slot confirmed as available. Example: 2026-05-05 09:00
